comment: Shared repository full name grammar for Python API writes and URL consumers plus Rust CLI deploy preflight. Both lanes preserve valid spelling exactly and reject every invalid value before persistence or network access.

valid.name: simple
valid.why: The common owner and repository pair is accepted.

valid.name: mixed_case_preserved
valid.why: Owner and repository casing is valid and must not be normalized.

valid.name: owner_hyphen
valid.why: A nonterminal single hyphen is legal in a GitHub owner login.

valid.name: repository_punctuation
valid.why: Repository dots, underscores, and hyphens are all legal.

valid.name: repository_leading_dot
valid.why: A repository may begin with a dot when it is not exactly dot or dot dot.

valid.name: single_character_segments
valid.why: One character owner and repository names are valid.

valid.name: maximum_owner_length
valid.why: A GitHub owner login may contain 39 characters.

invalid.name: empty
invalid.why: A repository binding needs both segments.

invalid.name: missing_separator
invalid.why: The owner and repository must be separated by exactly one slash.

invalid.name: empty_owner
invalid.why: The owner segment cannot be empty.

invalid.name: empty_repository
invalid.why: The repository segment cannot be empty.

invalid.name: extra_path_segment
invalid.why: Only one owner and repository pair is accepted.

invalid.name: double_separator
invalid.why: An empty segment cannot hide inside extra slashes.

invalid.name: dot_owner_traversal
invalid.why: A dot owner is a path traversal segment.

invalid.name: parent_owner_traversal
invalid.why: A dot dot owner is a path traversal segment.

invalid.name: dot_repository_traversal
invalid.why: A dot repository is a path traversal segment.

invalid.name: parent_repository_traversal
invalid.why: A dot dot repository is a path traversal segment.

invalid.name: encoded_traversal
invalid.why: Percent encoded traversal is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: https_url
invalid.why: A full URL is not a repository full name.

invalid.name: ssh_url
invalid.why: An SSH URL is not a repository full name.

invalid.name: scheme_character
invalid.why: A colon cannot introduce URL scheme syntax.

invalid.name: userinfo_character
invalid.why: An at sign cannot introduce URL user information.

invalid.name: carriage_return
invalid.why: A carriage return cannot enter a repository or HTTP path.

invalid.name: line_feed
invalid.why: A line feed cannot enter a repository or HTTP path.

invalid.name: tab
invalid.why: A tab cannot enter a repository or HTTP path.

invalid.name: percent_syntax
invalid.why: Percent syntax cannot smuggle a path delimiter.

invalid.name: query_syntax
invalid.why: A question mark cannot escape into a URL query.

invalid.name: fragment_syntax
invalid.why: A hash cannot escape into a URL fragment.

invalid.name: backslash
invalid.why: A backslash is not a repository character or structural separator.

invalid.name: leading_space
invalid.why: Whitespace is rejected instead of silently trimmed.

invalid.name: trailing_space
invalid.why: Whitespace is rejected instead of silently trimmed.

invalid.name: embedded_space
invalid.why: Whitespace cannot appear inside either segment.

invalid.name: owner_leading_hyphen
invalid.why: A GitHub owner login cannot begin with a hyphen.

invalid.name: owner_trailing_hyphen
invalid.why: A GitHub owner login cannot end with a hyphen.

invalid.name: owner_consecutive_hyphens
invalid.why: A GitHub owner login cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

invalid.name: owner_underscore
invalid.why: A GitHub owner login does not accept repository punctuation.

invalid.name: owner_dot
invalid.why: A GitHub owner login does not accept repository punctuation.

invalid.name: owner_too_long
invalid.why: A GitHub owner login cannot exceed 39 characters.

invalid.name: repository_too_long
invalid.why: A repository cannot exceed 100 characters.

invalid.name: unicode_repository
invalid.why: The repository grammar is ASCII only.

invalid.name: reserved_bang
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_dollar
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_ampersand
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_quote
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_parentheses
invalid.why: Reserved URL characters are not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_asterisk
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_plus
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_comma
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_semicolon
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_equals
invalid.why: A reserved URL character is not repository syntax.

invalid.name: reserved_brackets
invalid.why: Reserved URL characters are not repository syntax.
